scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state stationary equations and positive-coefficient sign proof are given; computational tests verify algebra but are not relied on as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies a specifically normalized, four-state open reaction–transport channel. No thermodynamic, infinite-volume, hydrodynamic, or general unequal-boundary-rate conclusion follows; a previously unlocated equivalent calculation is possible.
title: Exact covariance-sign phase diagram in a two-site birth–annihilation exclusion channel
